name: pidp1-hacker-replicant
description: AI tutor/copilot chat panel for Oscar Vermeulen's PiDP-1 replica -- knows Spacewar!, MACRO, and LISP on the PDP-1, and can optionally mount a paper tape and boot it. LLM-agnostic: works with any OpenAI-compatible backend (Ollama locally by default, or any hosted provider).
